items.text:
The controls and interface are pretty hard to navigate, I don't mean the ship controls either (I actually like those) I mean the menus, why does the "jobs" menu take up half the screen when I need to click it and then things in front of me? why is it such a pain to use? why cant I make irregular shaped areas? why cant I edit an area after creation? etc

it's also not really super clear whats going on, for instance my character had a sad face, 10 seconds later they're exhausted from being up for 72 hours (I don't think I've even been playing that long, the sleep bar was empty?) then they pass out and die from asphyxiation. I'm assuming there was an invisible leak in the ship - run ended. I don't mind if a game is hard or punishing, but I'd at least like to know what I did wrong and how I screwed up and whats actually going on.

Also the start is rough, they've added a tutorial to try to guide you through it which is nice but the tutorial doesn't tell you that your starting tools are worthless and there's better ones you can get right away etc, it also happens after you've softlocked yourself in the character creator in which you have no real idea what is good or bad, and you've chosen a literal deathtrap ship your first time because you're clueless. Unless you wanna struggle through all of this you'll probably wanna watch a youtube video just to grasp the fundamentals.

And If the game is supposed to be a rougelike where you die all the time and learn from your mistakes it's way too slow for that. If it's supposed to be a spaceship simulator where you play one character for a long time and build an empire then it's probably too clunky and punishing for that.

I'm sure I could force myself over the hump to really get into it but I'm just not sure the games worth it, I'll probably check back after full release but I wouldn't recommend the game lightly to anyone right now.
items.text_zh:
控制和界面相当难以操作，我说的不是飞船控制（实际上我喜欢那些），我说的是菜单，为什么“工作”菜单占据半个屏幕，而我还需要点击它然后再点击我面前的东西？为什么用起来这么痛苦？为什么我不能创建不规则形状的区域？为什么创建后不能编辑区域？等等

情况也不是特别清楚，比如我的角色有一张悲伤的脸，10秒后他们因为72小时没睡而精疲力竭（我觉得我甚至没玩那么久，睡眠条是空的？）然后他们昏倒并因窒息而死。我猜飞船上有看不见的泄漏——游戏结束。我不介意游戏难或惩罚性强，但至少我想知道我做了什么错事，我怎么搞砸的，以及到底发生了什么。

而且开局很艰难，他们添加了一个教程来尝试引导你，这很好，但教程没有告诉你你的起始工具毫无价值，有更好的工具你可以马上获得等等，它还发生在你在角色创建器中把自己软锁之后，你根本不知道什么是好是坏，而且你第一次就选了一艘字面意义上的死亡陷阱飞船，因为你一无所知。除非你想挣扎着度过这一切，否则你可能想看个YouTube视频来掌握基础知识。

如果游戏应该是一个你不断死亡并从错误中学习的roguelike，那它太慢了。如果它应该是一个你长期扮演一个角色并建立帝国的太空飞船模拟器，那它可能太笨重和惩罚性太强了。

我相信我可以强迫自己越过这个坎真正投入进去，但我不确定这游戏值不值得，我可能会在正式发布后再来看看，但现在我不会轻易向任何人推荐这个游戏。
